resources.string: Choose where your code and tools run.
Work on your phone. No server setup.
Connect to an existing OpenCode server.
Manage folders shared with local agents.
Stop the local server and interrupt its active tasks?
Share the last known location and its original timestamp with this session? It may be out of date and may be sent to the model. No new location will be requested.
The local agent requested a single location reading. The result may be sent to the model used by this session.
Local server active. Tap to open.
Share a folder with local agents. Content they read may be sent to your model.
List and read files without changing them.
Also allow creating and editing files.
Remove access to %1$s? Its files will not be deleted.
The document provider granted read-only access.
Could not retain access. Choose a document provider that supports persistent access.
The local agent requested this action. Any returned data may be sent to the session model.\n\n%1$s

The local agent requests up to %1$d seconds of audio (%2$s, %3$d Hz, %4$d channel(s), target %5$d bits/s). The recording will be saved to the workspace where the agent can read it. Leaving this screen stops recording.
Recording for up to %1$d seconds. You can stop it at any time.
Record with no time limit (%1$s, %2$d Hz, %3$d channel(s), target %4$d bits/s)? The recording is saved to the workspace where the agent can read it. Tap Stop or leave this screen to end recording.
Recording with no time limit. Tap Stop or leave this screen to end recording.
Replace the contents of an NFC tag?
After confirmation, tap only the tag you want to overwrite. Its previous NDEF records will be replaced with this text:\n\n%1$s
Hold one NDEF tag against the phone until the operation finishes.
Keep this job across device reboots?
Allow this retained job to run again?

Android keeps this registration after reboot. The local server does not start at boot; after a restart you must reopen it and confirm the script again. Cancelling the job or explicitly stopping the server removes it.
Battery: wait while battery is low
Battery: may run even when low
Storage: wait while device storage is low

%1$s
%2$s

This script will run with the app’s access while the local server is active. Review the complete script, including any external commands it invokes:

%3$s
Share new location fixes with this session for up to 3 minutes. Coordinates may be sent to your model. Stop here at any time; leaving the local screen also stops sharing.
Give a workspace program USB access?

Device: %1$s (%2$s)
Receiver: %3$s

This program can read and write the device until it closes its descriptor or the device is detached. Only approve a receiver you trust.
Share a page of text messages?

Mailbox: %1$s · Address: %2$s
Select %5$s: skip %3$d, then share up to %4$d messages.

Phone numbers, message bodies and dates will be returned to this session and may be sent to its model. This does not mark messages as read.
Share a page of call history?
Skip the newest %1$d calls; share up to %2$d records. Phone numbers, call types, times and durations will be returned to this session and may be sent to its model. The call log will not be changed.
Take a photo for this workspace?
The system camera will open. Only the photo you accept will be saved at full size in the workspace, where the local agent can read it.

Mailbox: %1$s · Address: %2$s
Order conversations by their last matching message, %8$s: skip %3$d and share up to %4$d. In each, select %7$s: skip %5$d messages and share up to %6$d.

Thread IDs, numbers, bodies and dates are returned to this session and may be sent to its model. Messages are not marked as read.
%1$s: collect %2$d samples per sensor, at least %3$d ms apart, for this session. You can cancel without sharing partial results.
Skip %1$d contacts with phone numbers, then share up to %2$d. Each name and one phone number will be returned to this session and may be sent to its model. Contacts will not be changed.
Continuously share %1$s with this session (at least %2$d ms between readings per sensor). Sharing stops when you tap Stop, the session requests stop, or you leave the local screen.
File: %1$s\n\nChoose the recipient on the next screen. That app can read and save a copy of this file, not write to the original.
all %1$d visible sensors (may increase battery use): %2$s
Turn off adaptive brightness and set this device to %1$d/255. This also affects other apps. Android may ask you to allow OpenCode to modify system settings.
Enable adaptive brightness for this device, including other apps. Android may ask you to allow OpenCode to modify system settings.
Dots only hide what is displayed. Share original sends your exact input to this session and it may be sent to the model. Cancel shares nothing. Do not enter passwords or keys.\n\n%1$s
Tap an option to share it
Android will open a speech recognizer. It may use the microphone and its own online service. OpenCode will show the words before you decide whether to share them.\n\n%1$s
Only the text below will be returned to this session and may be sent to the model. Cancel to discard it.\n\n%1$s
%1$s\n\nNew workspace file: %2$s (never overwrites an existing file).
Read this text aloud using the %1$s volume group?\n\n%2$s
Requested speech engine: %1$s. If it cannot connect, Android may use your default engine. Allow it to read this text?\n\n%2$s
Open camera %1$s? Tap the shutter to take a photo. Only the photo you accept will be saved to the workspace and shared with this session.
%1$s\n\nNew workspace photo: %2$s (never overwrites an existing file).
Download this URL using Android Download Manager?\n%1$s
Save as new workspace file: %1$s. Existing files are never overwritten.
Vibrate once for %1$d ms? Silent mode skips this request. Leave this screen to stop.
Request %1$d ms of vibration even in silent mode? Android policy still applies. Leave this screen to stop.
Share this Wi-Fi connection’s local IPv4 and MAC addresses, access point identifiers and link details with this session? Android may mask the local MAC. The results may be sent to the model.
Share cached Wi-Fi scan results, including network names, BSSIDs, frequencies, security capabilities and any operator or venue names? They may be sent to the session model.

Request a Wi-Fi scan and share the currently cached results, including network names, BSSIDs, frequencies, security capabilities and any operator or venue names? They may be sent to the session model.
Requested: turn Wi-Fi on. You control the switch in Android Wi-Fi Settings. Press Back to return; OpenCode will report whether Wi-Fi is on.
Requested: turn Wi-Fi off. You control the switch in Android Wi-Fi Settings. Press Back to return; OpenCode will report whether Wi-Fi is off.
Send reply to OpenCode for the session

Share mobile data status, network and SIM operator, phone type/count and device software version with this session? Android Phone permission is required. No phone number or persistent device or subscriber ID is shared.
Could not open this attachment. Try choosing a file again.
The camera did not return a photo.
Camera permission is needed to take a photo. You can still choose a file.

Share visible GSM, WCDMA, CDMA, LTE and 5G cells with this session? Details can include cell IDs, CDMA base station latitude and longitude, network codes, location or tracking areas, bands and signal metrics. This information can reveal your location.
OpenCode notification command\n\nReview the entire command. Allowing it once runs it with the app’s permissions; it can read or change OpenCode’s private data.
Notification command failed or timed out
